description: Verify a token minted by qm_attest. Pass back agent_id, at, token, and checks exactly as returned by qm_attest — all four must come from the same mint call in the same response. Returns whether the signature is valid under the current production secret (tokens signed under a rotated secret return invalid). Read-only; free, anonymous. Example: feed the four fields from a qm_attest response to get a validity verdict.

checks.description: Checks array exactly as returned by qm_attest.

name: qm_attest_verify
